title: Angelic Mirror Portal
description: A surreal scene shows a large ornate golden frame mounted on a decaying wall covered in vines, film reels, and scattered objects. An angel with large blue wings and white robes embraces a man in an orange jumpsuit from behind as he reaches toward a woman in a dark blue gown and crown standing inside a second mirror, while a translucent purple angel stands beside her.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a man in an orange jumpsuit being embraced by a blue-winged angel with white robes as he reaches toward a crowned woman inside a mirror portal. A translucent purple angel stands beside her. The scene is set against a crumbling wall overgrown with vines and littered with old film reels and objects, with a dramatic red sunset sky, distant gothic castle, and flying birds visible through a large broken golden picture frame.
